textbookBox.ref: CBSE Class 7 english · Sentence structure (additional, not in the textbook) · Textbook Concepts
textbookBox.concept: A simple sentence has one main clause: I play cricket. A compound sentence joins two main clauses with a conjunction like and, but, or: I play and she reads.

1.tip: Look closely at the diagram on the board as we explain each property.

beats.en: A simple sentence has one main clause: I play cricket. A compound sentence joins two main clauses with a conjunction like and, but, or: I play and she reads.
beats.speakEn: A simple sentence has one main clause: I play cricket. A compound sentence joins two main clauses with a conjunction like and, but, or: I play and she reads.

beats.en: A complex sentence has a main clause and a subordinate clause that cannot stand alone: I play when she reads. When she reads is the subordinate clause.
beats.speakEn: A complex sentence has a main clause and a subordinate clause that cannot stand alone: I play when she reads. When she reads is the subordinate clause.
